name: ontodynamics
description: Complete E0 landscape. Layers 0-8: Ontodynamics canon (pre-physical primitives, derivation topology, Axiom A0, emergence). Layers 9-17: Implementation (navigation, modulation, reflexion, multiverse, observation, dream mode, structural entropy, sleep-wake cycle). Derivation order encoded in delta topology. Confidence values reflect empirical validation from 3464 tests across 94 test files.

nodes.label: Difference
nodes.description: Primitive, effective, directed, scaled. Entities are the result of stabilized difference.

nodes.label: Local Realization
nodes.description: Difference can be realized partially, not only globally. Minimal condition for actuality.

nodes.label: Connection
nodes.description: Elementary topological operation. Multiple difference components realized together.

nodes.label: Gradual Overlap
nodes.description: Connections possess degree. Stability is an effect of sufficient overlap.

nodes.label: Historization
nodes.description: Realized connections leave irreversible structural trace. The cost of reality.

nodes.label: State
nodes.description: A stabilized configuration of historized connections.

nodes.label: Resistance
nodes.description: The integration cost of reconfiguring historized topology.

nodes.label: Time
nodes.description: The ordering of realized transitions. Local, emergent, path-dependent.

nodes.label: Path
nodes.description: Structural admissibility condition for transitions. A path exists iff total resistance is finite.

nodes.label: Rate
nodes.description: Effectiveness of realization relative to integration cost.

nodes.label: Spacetime
nodes.description: The globally historized topology of realized connections.

nodes.label: Mass
nodes.description: Persistent topological inertia from accumulated historization.

nodes.label: Axiom A0 — Difference Minimization
nodes.description: If difference exists and a structurally admissible path with finite resistance is available, then transition is structurally more stable than non-transition. The foundational law of E0.

nodes.label: Core Operational Cycle
nodes.description: Detection of local differences, enumeration of admissible paths, estimation of resistance, selection by realizability, execution, structural historization. Learning is not optional.

nodes.label: Structural Admissibility
nodes.description: Must reject transitions that collapse partial into global, cannot integrate into structure, simulate irreversibility without trace, or bypass resistance via global optimization.

nodes.label: Reflexivity Emergence
nodes.description: Emerges when system models own transition structure. Self-modification becomes admissible transition. Historization constrains future self-changes. Structurally induced, not architecturally imposed.

nodes.label: Structural Alignment
nodes.description: Arises mechanically, not normatively. High-impact transitions incur high resistance. Global resets destroy historized structure. Constrains classes of failure, not outcomes.

nodes.label: Domain Invariance
nodes.description: Does not depend on sensory modality, symbol systems, embodiment, or task environment. Domain specificity enters only through embedding, not through mechanism.

nodes.label: Negative Necessity
nodes.description: Conditions under which avoiding intelligence becomes structurally unstable. Not a positive construction claim. Persistent non-intelligent behavior cannot be maintained without structural degeneration.

nodes.label: Effective Tension
nodes.description: S_eff(x,y) = Δ(x,y) · R_eff(x,y). The composite navigation signal. R_eff = R₀ + δ_H(U,F). Greedy selection minimizes S_eff. Validated by P1 (5 benchmark domains).

nodes.label: Greedy Navigation
nodes.description: argmin S_eff/(M_H·I) with amplitude override. The core decision loop: enumerate admissible edges, compute penalized tension, select minimum. Recovers from 4 escalation types.

nodes.label: Escalation Recovery
nodes.description: Four escalation types: DEAD_END (no edges), FILTERED (all filtered by historization), EXHAUSTED (max steps), OVERLOADED (OI > threshold → peer consultation). Each triggers specific recovery.

nodes.label: Amplitude Override
nodes.description: High-Δ edges beat greedy selection when Δ·confidence exceeds threshold. Non-perturbative correction to greedy. Validated by P2 (amplitude paper).

nodes.label: Born Sampling
nodes.description: Probabilistic edge selection weighted by amplitude. Breaks greedy determinism. Enables exploration of high-Δ alternatives.

nodes.label: SU(2) Phase Geometry
nodes.description: Non-abelian phase accumulation on edges. Multi-axis spinor phases. Phase modulates amplitude. Validated by P3 (non-abelian structure).

nodes.label: Exploration Policy
nodes.description: Stochastic exploration using Born-weighted sampling. Governs exploration-exploitation tradeoff via temperature-controlled randomness.

nodes.label: Overlap Modulation (M_H)
nodes.description: M_H(x→y) = max(0.2, Σ_z √(v(x,z)·v(z,y))). Greedy divides S_eff by M_H. Well-connected paths preferred. Validated by C98 (24 tests) + C100 (29 tests). Modulation never harms.

nodes.label: Inertia Modulation (I)
nodes.description: I(e) = 1 − α·(m/(m+μ))·(1−|q|). Greedy divides S_eff by I. Confused edges (|q|≈0) penalized, clear edges rewarded. Validated by C99 (21 tests) + C100 (29 tests).

nodes.label: Trace Quality
nodes.description: q(e) = (U−F)/(U+F+ε) ∈ (−1,+1). Directional signal: +1 = always succeeds, −1 = always fails, 0 = confused. Core metric for all modulation and reflexion decisions.

nodes.label: Trace Load
nodes.description: m(e) = U+F. Total experience intensity on an edge. High load = well-explored. Used in inertia_factor, anchor_score, and dream fingerprints.

nodes.label: Reflexion Stufe 1 (Reactive)
nodes.description: Stuck → propose edges from historization patterns. Pattern extraction from high-quality edges. Reactive: triggered only when navigation fails. Validated by P4.

nodes.label: Reflexion Stufe 2 (Proactive)
nodes.description: Frontier → propose edges before getting stuck. Anticipatory edge creation from partial patterns. More efficient than reactive. Validated by P4.

nodes.label: Self-Graph (Stufe 3)
nodes.description: E0 models own transition structure as navigable landscape. Self-modification becomes admissible transition. Historization constrains future self-changes. Validated by P4 (reflexive self-modification).

nodes.label: Scoped Reflexion
nodes.description: Historization-driven locality for edge proposals. locality = mean_load/(mean_load+μ), radius = ceil((1−ℓ)·D). Fresh landscapes → global scope, historized → local. Validated by C101-C104 (35 tests). P5 §10.4 Q2.

nodes.label: Adaptive μ
nodes.description: μ = |E|/|V| derived from landscape topology. Sparse graphs → fast localization, dense → slower. Eliminates fixed parameter. Validated by C105 (15 tests). P5 §10.4 Q1.

nodes.label: Multiverse
nodes.description: N≥2 coupled E0 systems navigating independent landscapes. Each universe has own historization. Coupling enables knowledge transfer. Validated by P6, C66-C71.

nodes.label: Cross-Reflexion
nodes.description: Edge proposals donated across universe boundaries. Donor patterns transferred with coupling_discount. Scoped variant (C107) uses donor-side locality. Validated by C69 benchmark.

nodes.label: Coupling Router
nodes.description: Dynamic partner selection for N>2 universes. RECOVERY/EXPLORATION dual pressure. Self-historizing coupling quality. CouplingSelfGraph for Stufe-3 coupling diagnosis. Validated by C66-C68.

nodes.label: Novelty Gate
nodes.description: Prevents Δ-collapse: filters coupling proposals that would reduce structural diversity. Ensures multiverse coupling remains productive. Validated by P6.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Coupling
nodes.description: Weight-based directional resistance: R₀(req→don) = base_resistance/donor.weight. Experienced donors contribute more easily. Validated by C67.

nodes.label: Observation Landscape
nodes.description: E0 observes own landscape as a navigable domain. O-Landscape with focus/move/defocus navigation. Scoped projection with configurable depth. Wired to server (REST) and client (UI). Validated by C94-C97 (146 tests).

nodes.label: Dream Mode
nodes.description: Passive cross-domain pattern recognition. DreamObserver registers N domains, runs dream_cycle (passive comparison, readiness partitioning, incremental Dream Landscape). Dream Landscape is self-historizing valid E0 Landscape. Validated by C109-C112 (88 tests).

nodes.label: Edge Fingerprint
nodes.description: f(e) = (q, m, I). Three-dimensional characterization of edge behavior: trace quality, trace load, inertia factor. Domain-agnostic representation enables cross-domain comparison.

nodes.label: Functional Equivalence
nodes.description: Quantile-based, order-invariant matching of edge fingerprints across domains. Two edges are functionally equivalent if they occupy similar positions in their respective domains' fingerprint distributions.

nodes.label: Bridge Hypothesis
nodes.description: Dream equivalences → cross-edge proposals. BridgeHypothesis + DreamBridgeResult. dream_coupling_discount (quality→coupling weight). propose_bridges feeds into cross_propose_edges. make_dream_peer_fn for non-invasive E0Controller integration.

nodes.label: Structural Temperature (T_s)
nodes.description: T_s = −Σ p·log(p) over state transition frequencies. Measures heat from unused paths. High T_s = many untried transitions. Rises during active navigation, drops during consolidation. Validated by C115 (32 tests).

nodes.label: Inscription Threshold
nodes.description: Type 1 forgetting: novelty > ε required for state inscription. T_s controls ε dynamically. Hot landscape = selective inscription, cold = accept everything. Controller opt-in. Validated by C115, C118 (9 tests).

nodes.label: Anchor Analysis
nodes.description: anchor_score = |q̄|·m_max·log(1+deg). States with high score are structurally anchored (clear traces, high load, high connectivity). Low-anchor states are decay candidates. Only new parameter: θ_base. Validated by C116 (20 tests).

nodes.label: Structural Decay
nodes.description: Type 2 forgetting: 3-phase execution (trace → remove → clean). Landscape.remove_state, Historization.remove_edges. DecayTrace + DecayReport. Dream mode: decay_enabled opt-in. Validated by C117 (23 tests), C119 (9 tests).

nodes.label: Dream Pressure
nodes.description: dream_pressure = T_s/(T_s+μ) ∈ [0,1). Parameter-free trigger using existing μ. should_dream ⟺ T_s > μ ⟺ pressure > 0.5. Self-regulating: dreaming reduces T_s which reduces pressure.

nodes.label: Sleep-Wake Cycle
nodes.description: Automatic rhythm: wake (controller navigation builds experience) → check dream_pressure → sleep (dream_cycle consolidation + structural decay) → wake. Self-sustaining limit cycle: Learn → Heat → Dream → Cool → Learn. Validated by C121 (17 tests).
